discovery: Development of massively parallel next-generation DNA sequencing (sequencing by synthesis)
rationale: The 2025 prize went to materials chemistry (MOFs), so the committee may turn back to chemistry with biological impact. Solexa/Illumina sequencing-by-synthesis rests on chemistry: reversible-terminator nucleotides and surface cluster amplification. It changed genomics, medicine and diagnostics. The same trio already won the Breakthrough Prize (2022) and the Millennium Technology Prize (2020), which often comes before a Nobel.
